page.title: WhatsApp
page.description: Your agents answer WhatsApp chats and voice notes, and send messages during and after calls.
page.info: Connect your business number through Meta, pick the agent that answers it, and turn on WhatsApp tools in each agent. Meta bills its own fees for template messages to the card in your WhatsApp Manager.
page.loadFailed: Could not load your WhatsApp numbers.
page.connectedNotice: {number} is connected. Pick the agent that answers it.
page.toolsHint: To send WhatsApp messages during phone calls, turn on WhatsApp tools in an <link>agent</link>.
page.whichNumberLine: Meta opens in a new window. Sign in with the Facebook account that manages your business.
page.choiceNewLine: A number not used in WhatsApp yet, or one you can move off the WhatsApp Business app. The agent answers every chat.
page.choiceAppTitle: The number on my WhatsApp Business app
page.choiceAppLine: Keep using the app on your phone. The agent answers too, and steps back for a while when you reply yourself.
page.featureChatsLine: With its prompt, knowledge and tools.
page.featureTemplatesLine: Approved messages, any time after a call.
page.introStep1: Connect your business number with Meta.
page.introStep2: Pick the agent that answers it.
page.introStep3: Customers message you; the agent replies.
page.introNote: You need a Meta business account, and a payment method in WhatsApp Manager to send templates. Meta bills those fees to you directly.
page.manualConnectedLine: This number is in {appName}'s own Meta app, which already sends its messages here. There is nothing to set up in Meta. Send it a WhatsApp message to try it.
page.webhookLine: In your Meta app, open WhatsApp > Configuration, choose Edit next to Webhook, and paste these two values. Then subscribe to the messages field.
page.verifyTokenOnce: Shown once. Connect the number again to get a new one.
page.manualTitle: Connect with your own Meta app
page.manualLine: For a number already set up in a Meta app you manage. Find these in your app under WhatsApp > API Setup and App settings > Basic.
page.name: Label (optional)
page.accessTokenHint: A system user token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management.
page.appSecretHint: Used only to check that messages really come from Meta.

account.refreshed: Read the number from Meta again.
account.disconnectConfirm: Agents stop answering and sending from it, and its chats are deleted from {appName}. The number stays yours in WhatsApp Manager.
account.answeringAgentLine: Its prompt, knowledge and tools answer every message to this number.
account.noAgentOption: No agent: messages are kept, not answered
account.webhookOk: Meta is sending this number's messages here.
account.webhookWaiting: Nothing has arrived from Meta yet. In your Meta app, set this callback URL with the verify token you were shown, and subscribe to messages.
account.webhookError: Meta's last delivery failed. Check the callback URL and verify token in your Meta app.
account.noChatsLine: Message this number from your own phone to see the agent answer.
account.pickChat: Pick a chat to read it.
account.templatesSynced: {count, plural, one {# template} other {# templates}} from WhatsApp Manager.
account.templatesIntro: Templates are the only messages allowed more than 24 hours after someone last wrote: reminders, confirmations, follow-ups. Meta reviews each one before it can be sent.
account.noTemplatesLine: Write one with New template. Meta usually approves it within minutes.
account.valuesToFill: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to fill in} one {# value to fill in} other {# values to fill in}}
account.deleteLine: It is deleted from WhatsApp Manager too. Agents that send it will stop finding it, and Meta does not let you reuse the name for 30 days.
account.answersMessagesHint: Off keeps the number for sending only, for reminders and messages from calls.
account.voiceReplies: Answer voice notes with a voice note
account.voiceRepliesHint: In the agent's own voice. Engines without a text voice reply in text.
account.typingHint: Also marks the person's message as read.
account.label: Label
account.inactivity: Close a chat after this many quiet minutes
account.inactivityHint: 1 to 1440. The next message starts a new chat.
account.humanPause: After you reply from the WhatsApp Business app, the agent waits (minutes)
account.humanPauseHint: 0 to 1440. Only for a number shared with the WhatsApp Business app.
account.fallbackReply: Reply when your plan's message limit is reached
account.fallbackReplyPlaceholder: Thanks for your message. We will reply soon.
account.fallbackReplyHint: Sent once per chat instead of an AI reply. Leave empty to send nothing.

agent.title: WhatsApp
agent.info: What the agent can send on WhatsApp, on phone calls and in chats. It only ever sends to the person it is talking to.
agent.toolTemplatesLine: Confirmations and details, at any time.
agent.toolMessagesLine: Free text, if the caller wrote in the last 24 h.
agent.purposeBookingHint: Filled with name, date and time, by how many values it takes.
agent.purposeReminderHint: Used for reminders the agent schedules, and before bookings.
agent.purposeFollowUpHint: Used for follow-ups the agent schedules after a call.
agent.connectNumber: Connect a WhatsApp number to let this agent chat and send messages.
agent.answersNone: Answers no WhatsApp chats yet. Pick it for a number on the <link>WhatsApp</link> page.
agent.templatesInfo: Only approved templates can be sent more than 24 hours after someone last wrote. Write them on the number's page and Meta approves them within minutes.
agent.noApproved: No approved templates on this number yet.
agent.confirmBookingsHint: Sends the booking confirmation template as soon as the agent books an appointment.
agent.reminderMinutesHint: 0 is off. Uses the reminder template.
agent.maxSendsHint: Through its WhatsApp tools, on one call or chat turn.
agent.allowMarketingHint: Off by default: Meta limits marketing messages, and a low-quality number gets restricted.

signup.cancelled: Sign-up was closed before it finished.
signup.sdkFailed: Meta's sign-up could not load. Check that nothing is blocking facebook.com, and try again.
signup.noAnswer: Meta's sign-up did not answer. If no window opened, allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
signup.noNumber: Meta finished without a number. Pick or add a phone number in the sign-up.
signup.onlyWaba: The sign-up finished without a phone number. Run it again and add the number.
signup.metaErrorUnknown: Meta: the sign-up hit an error.
signup.noSession: Meta did not say which number was picked. Try again.

template.title: New template
template.description: Meta reviews it before it can be sent, usually within minutes. Its status updates here when you sync.
template.name: Name
template.messagePlaceholder: Hi '{{1}}', a reminder of your visit on '{{2}}'.

errors.planGate: WhatsApp is not included in your plan. Upgrade your plan to connect a number.
